title: 2001 HMMT February Guts Problem 12
statement: How many distinct sets of 8 positive odd integers sum to 20 ?

solutions.text: This is the same as the number of ways 8 nonnegative even integers sum to 12 (we subtract 1 from each integer in the above sum). All 11 possibilities are (leaving out 0s): \(12,10+2,8+4,8+2+2,6+6,6+4+2,6+2+2+2+2,4+4+4,4+4+2+2\), \(4+2+2+2+2,2+2+2+2+2+2\).
